name: Mikoto
source:
Hobby: Tracking people, sneaking
Favorite food: [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anpan]Anpan[/url], milk
Hated food: Foods that are "free if you finish them in a certain time limit"
Affiliation: Informal newspaper club, Kazami affiliated junior high class 2-3

Informal staff newspaper girl. She respects [url=/c5315]Suginami[/url] more than anything in this world.

[spoiler]In her route in D.C. III D.D, she revealed that her surname was "Shirakawa" while talking to Kiyotaka about the idea of joining the school pageant and her hate and anxieties about using the surname. [/spoiler]
